sealedPaidSlice.$comment: The sealed paid point/list slice (sdk-fixture appendix; matched-cost-scope-review 'Bounded C follow-through'), in C's native representation. Source-only: no run, no number is claimed here. This packet RECORDS observations (inputEvidenceGrade RPC_OBSERVED); the expectation manifest, the arm-input manifest and the post-B1 basis seal are authored, hashed and timestamped by the INDEPENDENT run controller before this packet is opened, and this packet may echo but never define or repair them.
sealedPaidSlice.scope: anvil-only: the cell evm_snapshots, evm_reverts and evm_setNextBlockTimestamps, so script/measure.mjs refuses it without --anvil BEFORE any chain call (assertAnvilOnlyCells); deselect it with --cells to run the other cells against a supplied RPC

rows.A1-create: setup: AUTHOR_A signed: subject FILE_QUOTE + QUOTE_A1 + A head (rev 1) + the ONE /swaps eth-usdc placement + market tag; one combined receipt (costClass setup). The placement is one of five actions and NOT separable: placementCost ESTIMATE unless the paired control is pinned
rows.A2-edit: setup: AUTHOR_A signed: QUOTE_A2 + HEAD CAS rev 1 -> 2; A1 retained in history; the placement is untouched
rows.B1-create: setup: AUTHOR_B (Producer, native): QUOTE_B1 + B's own HEAD rev 1; NO FOLDER bind (a competing content head only, never a second placement); calldata carries two actions
rows.seal: after B1, before any paid read: evm_snapshot id + block number/hash/timestamp + raw replies at that block (highWater = baseline + 9, index generation, rules epoch, Core code commitment, realmId, realmOrigin); A placement provenance (resolveAt under both lenses -> identical A placement; Admissions + Evidence rows via public getRecord: FOLDER bind of /swaps/eth-usdc -> FILE admitted by the retained A1 publicationId, AUTHOR_A, proofKind 2, native at source; one Scopes triple (A, eth-usdc, A's key)); no B placement (B's Bindings row revision 0, BindingHistory length 0, [B]-only lens ABSENT_PROVEN)
rows.paid-point-A: PAID_POINT / LENS_A_FIRST: MeasurementConsumer.paidPoint([A,B], Expect) from the pinned unrelated caller; first and only tx of block seal+1 at timestamp seal+1
rows.paid-list-A: PAID_LIST / LENS_A_FIRST: paidList([A,B], Expect, PlacementExpect{/swaps, eth-usdc, AUTHOR_A, proofKind 2, A1 publicationId, revision 1, budget 10})
rows.paid-point-B: PAID_POINT / LENS_B_FIRST: paidPoint([B,A], Expect for QUOTE_B1 / B1 / AUTHOR_B / proofKind 1)
rows.paid-list-B: PAID_LIST / LENS_B_FIRST: the same single A placement row, checked to the B1 selection; placement actor AUTHOR_A != selected author AUTHOR_B by design
rows.ordering: seal -> (evm_revert to the seal, observed head == seal, re-snapshot, evm_setNextBlockTimestamp(seal+1), empty pool) -> the row -> retained (receipt, PaidObserved log, eth_call replay from the same caller at the receipt block, block transaction list, abstractResult, persisted) -> next revert; asserted by checkPaidRowOrdering (txIndex 0, single tx == row hash, equal block/parent/timestamp across the four rows)
rows.agreement: point and list under the same lens observe the identical Selection (lensHash excluded); unknown, never agreement, when a log is missing or its self-check failed
rows.exact-retry-A1: matched failure control: AlreadyAdmitted (block-pinned static revert selector + separately mined status-0 receipt)

sealedPaidSlice.paidCaller: fixed ephemeral account of the run mnemonic at derivation index 3 (m/44'/60'/0'/0/3; anvil default mnemonic unless RUN_MNEMONIC/PAID_CALLER_INDEX are set): not the deployer (0), not AUTHOR_A (1), not the Producer or any deployed contract; assertUnrelatedCaller before setup; balance asserted > 0 at a pinned block; no secret retained

consumer.source: test/MeasurementConsumer.sol (test-only, stateless; paidPoint/paidList; framed c32 surface paidPointFramed/paidListFramed kept alongside)
consumer.decoder: consumer-local over the public read ABI only: getRecord(bytes32,bytes32[],bytes32) with the Records/Admissions/Evidence table ids, field layouts and packed offsets pinned as literals (README 'Fixture coordinates'); every static region is length-checked before any byte is read; no EfsTypes/EfsIds/table-library import; readers are called through interface types (ILensReads, ITableReads, ILedgerViews, IIndexReads) so test/FaultyReads.sol can substitute malformed ACTUAL replies
consumer.checks: shared by point and list: basis pinned exactly (highWater == Expect.basisAdmission, else BasisMismatch), resolveAt(HEAD, FILE_QUOTE, basis) FOUND with the expected author, head id and revision; the head's admission is a BIND of that target inside its publication's admission range whose Evidence names the author under the expected proof kind (native: v=r=s=0; EOA-signed: v in {27,28}, r,s != 0), not imported (importOf 0, sourceGrade 0), at this realmId and coreCodeCommitment; Quote -> Pair -> two Items with exact Type ids, canonical frames, ordered references, each admitted at or before the basis; the selected Quote's mantissa, scale, observedAt and note commitment compared against the caller's INPUTS. List only: one bounded page from a fresh cursor at the same basis must be COMPLETE with its end condition (next.position == rawTotal == scanned), rawTotal 1, one item, selected 1; the item is (eth-usdc -> FILE_QUOTE) held by the expected actor at the expected revision; FAMILY_SCOPES coverage COMPLETE through the basis; the placement's admission/publication/evidence category checked separately from content authorship (no equality between placement actor and selected author). Point performs no directory lookup.
consumer.observations: event PaidObserved(kind, commitment, Selection selection, Placement placement): Selection = basisAdmission, indexGeneration, rulesEpoch, coreCodeCommitment, realmId, lensHash, subject, selectedHead, selectedRevision, selectedAdmission, selectedBindingKey, selectedPublication, selectedAuthor, selectedProofKind, selectedSourceGrade, quoteFirstAdmission, pairId, itemA, itemB, mantissa, scale, observedAt, note (23 fields); Placement = folder, name, target, actor, revision, admission, bindingKey, publicationId, proofKind, sourceGrade, basisAdmission, pageStatus, rawTotal, scanned, hydrated, selected, endPosition, ended, coverageStatus, coverageThrough (20 fields; all-zero for a point row). commitment = keccak256(abi.encode(kind, selection, placement)). The log is the paid rows' instrumentation overhead: ESTIMATED ~12-14k gas, disclosed, never subtracted.
consumer.negatives: Forge: test/MeasurementConsumer.t.sol MeasurementSealedTest (wrong EXPECTATIONS: wrong/missing Pair or Item, wrong author or proof category, second placement via the broader FixtureSeeder.b1(), mixed bases, incomplete coverage, point/list disagreement, wrong head/revision/quote fields, wrong placement coordinate/revision/publication) and MeasurementFaultyReadsTest (malformed/missing ACTUAL replies through test/FaultyReads.sol: missing Pair row, wrong-Type Item, short Admissions region, short Evidence region, PARTIAL page claiming COMPLETE; plus the unarmed forwarding control)

abstractResult.labels: selectedFile FILE_QUOTE; selectedHead QUOTE_A2 / QUOTE_B1; selectedRevision A2 / B1 (fixture labels, never ordinals: physical ids/ordinals in selectedPhysical); selectedAuthor AUTHOR_A / AUTHOR_B with the principal id; selectedAuthorEvidenceCategory EOA_SIGNED_PUBLICATION / CONTRACT_ORIGINATED_PUBLICATION; placementProvenance sourceStep A1 / AUTHOR_A / EOA_SIGNED_PUBLICATION_EFFECT, unchanged under B-first; placementCoordinate.lookedUpByThisRow false for a point row
abstractResult.unknownCollapse: on any failed candidate self-check (no single PaidObserved log, undecodable replay, replay commitment != log commitment, any field != the runner's candidate-side expectation) every derived label, outcome and coverage is UNKNOWN with the reason; raw observations (log, replay, receipt, block) stay retained; only fields a SEPARATE retained observation establishes (seal replies, receipt/block) keep values, each naming its source; the run then fails after retention
abstractResult.builder: script/measure-helpers.mjs deriveAbstractResult / abstractRow (pure; unit-tested in script/measure-helpers.test.mjs)

optionalControlCell.selection: non-default; admitted only by its exact --cells name (selectCells); anvil-only
optionalControlCell.content: the identical A1 batch minus the FOLDER bind (subject + record + head + tag) from the same post-setup snapshot as typed-joined (same pre-A1 state, same author/nonce/bodies); asserts no /swaps/eth-usdc placement (lens ABSENT_PROVEN, A's Bindings row revision 0) and the A head present; pairing statement retained. The two receipts sit side by side; any difference is the coordinator's computation, this runner subtracts nothing

sealedPaidSlice.costClasses: reported separately, never subtracted, amortized or normalized: deployment (artifacts[] deploy:* gas, runtime/initcode bytes/hashes; production prerequisites apart from MeasurementConsumer and Producer; ImportLib linked but not called), code, setup (setup:types-items-pair + A1/A2/B1 receipts), placementOnceOnly (ESTIMATE unless the paired control is pinned), storage (UNKNOWN: no slot diff), paid (the four receipts from the pinned caller), matchedFailureControl (exact-retry-A1)
operatorChecklist: 1. The expectation manifest (the seven appendix rows as semantic labels/outcomes only), the C arm-input manifest (clean source commit + empty dirty diff, compiler/config, artifact/initcode/runtime hashes incl. MeasurementConsumer, profile/Type/Lens commitments, independently derived semantic-to-physical vectors) and the post-B1 basis seal are the INDEPENDENT run controller's: authored, hashed and timestamped before this packet is opened; never this packet's.
2. Build with the pinned solc 0.8.30 / via-IR / cancun into a run-owned OUT_DIR; run the Forge suite (expected 47 + 17 = 64 tests) before any chain run; report the fresh --sizes table.

3. Start an owned finite Anvil (see TODO.md lease recipe; --accounts >= 4 so mnemonic index 3 is funded) and run `node script/measure.mjs --anvil` (default cells) with EVIDENCE_PATH set; add `--cells typed-joined,typed-joined/a1-without-placement` to pin the paired control.

4. Verify in the packet: metadata.run, metadata.paidCaller, slices['typed-joined'].{caller, seal, placementAtSeal, noBPlacement, ordering, agreement, costDisclosure, mismatches == 0}, operations[cell typed-joined].abstractResult on the four paid rows (selfCheck.match true), the exact-retry-A1 status-0 row; re-derive every physical id from the controller's own vectors, never from slices[].fixtureMirror.
5. Any UNKNOWN abstractResult, non-zero mismatches, ordering assertion or missing raw reply keeps the row out of the comparison; the raw packet is still retained as a diagnostic.

reads.basis: block hash + Ledger highWater admission ordinal; LensReader cursors pin (basisAdmission, indexGeneration, rulesEpoch, coreCodeCommitment, scopeKey, lensHash, position)
reads.decoder: hand-written MUD-style table libraries (src/tables/*.sol) — candidate code; an independent oracle must re-derive from IStoreRead bytes + the FieldLayout/Schema words in README
reads.cursorSemantics: cursor = (basisAdmission, indexGeneration, rulesEpoch, coreCodeCommitment, scopeKey, lensHash, position); continuation at an older basis is answered via BindingHistory; stale generation/epoch/code reverts StaleCursor; wrong scope/lens reverts CursorMismatch; Page.selected counts this page only

1_originQualifiedIdentity.status: designed, tests written, unrun; adopted the coordinator handoff
1_originQualifiedIdentity.decision: deployment-bound identity: realmOrigin = keccak('efs2/origin/1', chainId, ledgerAddress); two Ledger deployments on one chain are two Realms by design; verified imports keep the original principal; codehash recorded as execution evidence only

2_evidenceReconstruction.note: MUD packs the 11 Admission fields into a 262-byte static region (9 slots) and the 17 Evidence fields into 325 bytes (11 slots); values are re-encoded with abi.encode for the digest so the packed layout never enters the signature.

3_import.status: designed, tests written, unrun; blocker repaired
3_import.decision: only EOA-signed (grade 1) sources are importable and are re-verified with the v/low-s guard; native (grade-zero) sources revert UnsupportedSourceProof — no attributed cell, no writes as that principal — until a chain-state witness profile exists (test_spoofViaImport_… covers the forgery path)
open: CAS on import uses the source action's expectedRevision against destination state (no override field)
imported DECLARE_TYPE rows bind the source acceptor ADDRESS, which may not exist on the destination — tests avoid importing Type declarations

4_cursor.decision: seven-field cursor; no caller-supplied running total is echoed (Page.selected counts this page only)
4_cursor.open: rawTotal is reported at current state, not at the cursor's basis (computing the basis-time count would require a scan)
